item: KPI panel method hover and block reasons read in the UI language (row 201, S08-02 S2): keyed frames beside the English
summary: Each KPI method was an English f-string with its figures welded in, so no locale key matched and the System tab hover read English in all 12 languages. kpi.py now builds every method and K13 block reason as keyed frames ({t, v, tr}: template key, data vars, tr vars whose word is itself a key) and BUILDS the English field from the same frames, byte-identical to before (every existing method test passes unchanged); the client renders them through OOI18N.tf, joined with nothing between (each piece carries its own punctuation), and falls back to the English for an older snapshot. The measure names, targets and snapshot caveat go through t() too. 148 keys x12 (non-en AI-drafted). tests/test_kpi_method_frames.py scans kpi.py's AST for every frame template, requires each keyed x12 with the same placeholders, and checks across recorded snapshots that every emitted frame was scanned and rebuilds its English. Release line: The measures panel in the task manager now explains each measure in your language.
